Package com.siemens.pki.cmpracomponent.protection

Class OutputSharedSecretCredentials

java.lang.Object
com.siemens.pki.cmpracomponent.protection.OutputSharedSecretCredentials
All Implemented Interfaces:
CredentialContext, SharedSecretCredentialContext
public class OutputSharedSecretCredentials extends Object implements SharedSecretCredentialContext
an instance implementing SharedSecretCredentialContext provides all attributes needed for shared secret based CMP protection of outgoing messages
